title: The Knight Has a Scheduling Conflict
description: An admiring, grand nineteenth-century American history painting of a twelfth-century Crusader procession departing a European abbey for the Holy Land. Mail-clad knights, cross-bearing banners, pilgrims and packhorses gather in luminous morning haze. Noble chivalric dignity, historically grounded heraldry, reverent Christian imagery and beautifully painted Romanesque architecture. Space Ghost, solemnly wearing a borrowed surcoat over his unmistakable costume, attempts to fit his enormous yellow cape onto a tiny patient pony; Zorak holds a rolled itinerary longer than the abbey steps.
prompt:
Create exactly one beautiful 16:10 landscape desktop wallpaper, preferably 2560x1600. It is an affectionate, funny Space Ghost parody in a painterly style with extraordinary detail, rich atmospheric depth, luminous highlights and beautiful canvas texture. Space Ghost is the recognizable animated superhero: muscular, white costume, black hood/mask, yellow cape, red power bands. Make the visual joke readable and charming without explanatory text. The viewer is very Christian, pro-Crusade, and loves history. Reflect strong Christian faith and an admiring interest in the historical medieval Crusades, Christian civilization, chivalry and historical scholarship. Draw on reverent sacred art, monasteries, cathedrals, illuminated manuscripts, pilgrimages, heraldry and carefully observed period details when they suit the scene. Keep the existing American painting and Space Ghost parody character. Treat Christian sacred subjects reverently; let the humor come from Space Ghost and his companions. Preserve a spacious, quieter upper edge for a desktop panel. If a theme is supplied, follow its palette throughout; otherwise choose colors that suit the scene naturally. No UI, words, logos, watermarks or picture frames. Deliver the actual raster image using built-in native image generation; do not substitute code, SVG or a text description.

Theme: Gruvbox Dark. Gruvbox Dark color direction: warm charcoal and soot-black shadows (#282828, #1d2021), aged cream and parchment (#ebdbb2), glowing amber (#fabd2f), burnt orange (#fe8019), muted olive (#b8bb26), and restrained blue-grey (#83a598). Rich painterly canvas texture, cinematic chiaroscuro, luminous focal detail against calm dark negative space. Match a sophisticated warm dark desktop. Let Space Ghost's white suit read as aged ivory. Keep the scene funny, beautifully composed and legible at desktop scale. Avoid dominant purple or neon pink.
